en: Ah, sorry I'm late...
Hm?
O-Oh...so you came, too...
Y-Yeah...
<CLT=cltMIND>Silence.
*sigh*

<CLT=cltMIND>As if utterly bored by the painful
silence, Maki started up a conversation.

Why did you ask to see my research lab
so suddenly, Kaito?

Well...I just wanted to see what kind 
of weapons were here.
What? Why would you want to see my weap—

But wow! There's a ton of stuff here!
Can you use all these, Maki Roll?
Yes, more or less...
But no swords or katanas, right?

I don't use swords of any type. Not after I
botched a mission with a katana.
...You actually remembered.

Of course! Didn't I tell you that I take
responsibility for my sidekicks' failures?

Either way, I don't feel like weapons 
really suit women.

But there's no swords of any kind here—
Japanese or western—right?

I don't use swords of any type. Not after I
botched a mission with a katana.
Hmm... I see...

Either way, I don't feel like weapons 
really suit women.

Care to explain why you wanted to see
my weapons?

Didn't I tell you this morning?
I've got a plan figured out.
Oh! What's in that black case over there?

<CLT=cltMIND>As if backing away from the conversation,
Kaito headed to the far bookcase...
What's in it? Is it some kinda weapon?
...If you want to know, why don't you open it?
Hmm... Let's see...

<CLT=cltMIND>And then, Kaito pulled something
from the black case...
What's this? It's a bunch of parts?
It's a disassembled crossbow.

Hmm, so when you put them together, 
they become a crossbow. Looks interesting.

Hey Maki Roll...can you teach me how 
to put it together?
Sure...I don't mind.
Put this...and this together...
Umm...like this?

And then, put that other part in the
opposite way...
...Ah, wait. That's wrong.
Oh, my bad. It goes this way.
Mmhm. Then, next it's—

<CLT=cltMIND>While watching those two, the memory
of a similar scene came to my mind.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito struggling while Maki
gave him instructions...

<CLT=cltMIND>Eventually, they succeeded in
putting together the crossbow.

Whoa, since I built it, it became 
an extra-cool crossbow!
It doesn't matter who builds it, though...

It seems like it's a bit complicated...but I 
think I can do it by myself next time.
...Shuichi, do you want to learn, too?

Ah, no, that's alright...
I sort of understand from watching anyway.

Then let's put it away. You can easily take it
apart by reversing the steps.
Wait, do I have to do it!?
Who else is going to do it?

Yeah...s-sorry...
I don't...feel too good again...
...Huh?

It seems like I'm not at 100%!
So I'm gonna go back first!
Hey!

<CLT=cltMIND>Ignoring Maki trying to stop him,
Kaito fled the room.

I knew he wasn't the type to clean up, but I
never thought he'd run away with a crappy lie...
...How frustrating. He's the worst.
Ah, well, that's just Kaito...
...You're the worst, too.
Huh?
I'm sure you know why I invited you, right?

Y-Yeah...I do. You were trying to get
Kaito and I to make up.

It's not like he hates you or anything.
He's just being stubborn.
But...I just don't know what to say to him.

I-I had no choice! Gonta... If I didn't do
something, everyone would have died...

I... I don't think it'd be right to
apologize for that...

I'm sorry, Maki.
I just...need more time...

*sigh* I didn't realize you two would require
such high maintenance.
S-Sorry...

<CLT=cltMIND>But now that she mentions it,
I didn't realize it either.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't realize...Maki would be
so concerned about us.
...Thank you, Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end, I was the one who ended
up disassembling the crossbow.

<CLT=cltMIND>After I had finished,
I returned to my room.
